# Official interface screenshots

These images show the actual public interfaces documented by Home Assistant and Nabu Casa. They contain demonstration data, not the author's private home. Downloaded 2026-09-22, without visual alteration of the interface. The Imager still is frame 65 extracted from the official animation. `sources.json` maps every file to its upstream source; each displayed image also links to its official tutorial.

`dashboard.png`, `onboarding.png`, `imager.png`, `automation.png`, `action.png`, `integrations.png`, `apps.png`.
